in_marathi.name: Manjesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manjesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manjesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘manjari’, meaning ‘gem’ or ‘jewel’. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Manjari is a consort of Lord Shiva and is often depicted holding a garland of jewels. This name symbolizes beauty, grace, and abundance.
